Built into WeraIconos.ttf by brand/render-fuente-iconos.sh; checked by node brand/iconos/iconos.mjs. The line's rules: README.md beside it.

primera._: Row 11.3-i draws every glyph these files name: the three tab bars, Wera's Inicio and Wera Cocina's Hoy. Hoy's four features are named in cocina/src/lib/loQueUsas.ts's ICONO_DE, beside glyphs that are not on Hoy, so the check reads that one object.

marcas._: A company's own mark is never ours to draw, and MaterialCommunityIcons' licence leaves its brand icons out (pictogrammers.com/docs/general/license, read 2026-11-26): each is its owner's own file, by its owner's own rules (brand/marcas/README.md, row 11.10-i). Google's G left the glyphs at 11.10-i: the sign-in buttons draw Google's own picture. WhatsApp's is Meta's own glyph since 11.10-iii, a picture from brand/marcas/whatsapp/ that @/ui/Icono draws for the name the apps write. inventario.json marks it `marca: true`.
